answer: Require random ambient-environment checks: at an unpredictable moment each epoch, each identity must submit a signed scan of nearby Wi-Fi and Bluetooth beacons plus an ambient sound hash. A farm cannot reuse one room for many identities: two identities sharing over 80% of beacons in the same window are flagged as one place, not two people, as the prism test splits one shared signal into its sources. A flagged identity is frozen and its 20-token bond burns, while a pearl-clean record keeps full weight. Running 100 fakes needs 100 distinct radio environments, not one ocean of cloned phones.
